Properties in Mivida Compound: Luxury Living in the Heart of New Cairo

New Cairo has become one of Egypt’s most prestigious residential destinations, offering modern infrastructure, organized urban planning, and a wide range of upscale gated communities. Among these developments, Emaar Mivida Compound stands out as one of the most iconic and successful residential projects in East Cairo.

Developed by Emaar Misr, emaar mivida compound is designed to deliver a fully integrated lifestyle that combines luxury, greenery, convenience, and long-term value. It is not just a residential compound—it is a master-planned community built around comfort, elegance, and sustainability.

Properties in emaar mivida compound continue to attract families, professionals, and investors who are looking for premium living standards in one of New Cairo’s most desirable locations.

Overview of Emaar Mivida Compound

Emaar Mivida Compound is a large-scale, master-planned residential development located in New Cairo’s Golden Square. The project is inspired by modern urban living concepts, with a strong focus on green spaces, walkability, and community interaction.

The word “Mivida” reflects “My Vida” or “My Life,” highlighting the project’s philosophy of creating a complete lifestyle environment rather than just housing units. Within emaar mivida compound, every element—from architecture to landscaping—is carefully designed to enhance the quality of daily living.

The compound includes residential units, commercial areas, parks, schools, and office spaces, making it a fully integrated community.

Prime Location of Mivida in New Cairo

One of the strongest advantages of emaar mivida compound is its strategic location in the heart of New Cairo, specifically in the Golden Square area.

Residents benefit from close proximity to:

  • 90th Street (South and North)
  • The American University in Cairo (AUC)
  • Cairo Festival City Mall
  • New Administrative Capital
  • Major highways including Ring Road and Suez Road

This central location makes emaar mivida compound ideal for families and professionals who need easy access to business districts, schools, and entertainment hubs while enjoying a peaceful residential environment.

Why Choose Emaar Mivida Compound?

World-Class Developer

Emaar Misr is one of the most reputable developers in Egypt and the region. The brand reputation adds strong trust and long-term value to emaar mivida compound.

Master-Planned Community

Mivida is designed as a self-sufficient city within New Cairo, offering everything residents need within walking distance or a short drive.

Green and Sustainable Design

A major portion of the compound is dedicated to landscaping, parks, and open spaces, creating a refreshing and eco-friendly environment.

High-End Lifestyle

emaar mivida compound is known for its luxury standards, modern design, and premium amenities.

Types of Properties in Mivida Compound

Apartments

Apartments in emaar mivida compound are designed for modern urban living.

  • Contemporary layouts
  • High-quality finishing
  • Spacious balconies
  • Open-plan living areas

These units are ideal for individuals, couples, and small families.

Duplex Units

Duplex apartments offer more space and privacy.

  • Two-level layouts
  • Separation between living and sleeping areas
  • Larger interior space
  • Family-friendly design

These units are popular among families seeking comfort and functionality.

Townhouses

Townhouses in emaar mivida compound provide a balance between villa living and apartment convenience.

  • Private gardens
  • Multiple floors
  • Modern architectural design
  • Semi-detached privacy

These homes are ideal for families who want outdoor space without full villa costs.

Villas

Villas represent the highest level of luxury within the compound.

  • Large private gardens
  • Spacious interiors
  • Premium finishes
  • Maximum privacy

These properties are designed for high-end buyers seeking exclusivity.

Lifestyle in Emaar Mivida Compound

Green Community Living

One of the defining features of emaar mivida compound is its emphasis on greenery. The compound includes:

  • Parks and landscaped gardens
  • Tree-lined streets
  • Walking and cycling paths
  • Open recreational spaces

This creates a healthy and relaxing lifestyle environment.

Community-Centered Design

Mivida is designed to encourage interaction between residents while maintaining privacy. Shared spaces, plazas, and community hubs support social engagement.

High-End Amenities

Residents of emaar mivida compound enjoy access to a wide range of facilities:

  • Clubhouses
  • Swimming pools
  • Fitness centers
  • Sports courts
  • Restaurants and cafes

These amenities enhance the overall living experience.

Family-Friendly Environment

emaar mivida compound is highly suitable for families due to:

  • Safe gated environment
  • Dedicated children’s play areas
  • International schools nearby
  • Pedestrian-friendly streets
  • Quiet residential zones

Families benefit from a secure and well-organized community.

Commercial and Business Hub

Mivida is not just residential—it also includes commercial and business components.

  • Retail areas
  • Office spaces
  • Service centers
